Subject: Pemberly Distribution - Referral Items Needed

Hi Dana,

Thanks for the Pemberly Distribution submission. I've reviewed the information and have a few questions before I can move forward.

This account requires referral due to:
- Coastal exposure (1 location within 16 km of coast)
- High portfolio accumulation in the area (existing TIV within 25 km)
- Loss history exceeding $250K over five years

To help me present this to our referral team, could you please provide:
- Details on the loss runs: causes, dates, and any mitigation measures taken since?
- Construction type and protection class for the coastal location?
- Any wind mitigation features in place?

If this doesn't fit our timeline, I'd recommend reaching out to a coastal specialist.

Happy to discuss!

[Underwriter name]
